FazaUserAccount.title: FazaUserAccount
FazaUserAccount.description: Authenticated Google user account linked to FAZA AI, keyed by Firebase Auth UID and storing the unique Google subject ID (sub).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID and request.auth.uid.

googleSub.description: Unique immutable Google account subject identifier (sub) used to identify the FAZA AI session.

displayName.description: User full display name from Google profile.

email.description: User Gmail address from verified Google account.

photoUrl.description: Optional Google profile picture URL (omitted when absent).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on initial account creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on profile updates.

lastSignInAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on sign-in.

FazaAiChatMessage.title: FazaAiChatMessage
FazaAiChatMessage.description: Private FAZA AI chat message isolated inside the owning user's subcollection.

userId.description: Owning Firebase Auth UID matching parent userId and request.auth.uid.

googleSub.description: Unique Google account subject identifier (sub) associated with the FAZA AI session.

modelName.description: Gemini model identifier used for assistant replies.

modeLabel.description: Short label of the active assistant mode.

usedGoogleSearch.description: Whether Google Search grounding was used for this message.

searchQueries.description: Bounded list of grounding search queries (max 20).

sources.description: Bounded list of grounding web sources (max 10).

timestampMs.description: Client ordering epoch timestamp in milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on message creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on message updates.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only FAZA AI Google account profile document storing unique Google sub ID and profile metadata.

/users/{userId}/ai_messages/{messageId}.description: Strictly isolated per-user FAZA AI conversation messages accessible only to the owning Google account.
